description: This file implements WebSocket connection handling for the Playwright core library, including classes for transport mechanisms (JSON pipe and WebSocket) and a function to establish WebSocket connections.

classes.name: JsonPipeTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication via a JSON pipe channel.

classes.name: WebSocketTransport
classes.description: Handles WebSocket communication directly via the browser's WebSocket API.

methods.name: connectOverWebSocket
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection and returns a Connection object.
